items.text: Cut every adjective that you cannot back with a fact.
high income opportunities start with a small piece of real output on your resume.
The objective only matters if it points at a real route.
A finished report or process map is a resume line no adjective can match.
Who pays you Small businesses, clubs and local firms.

blocks.heading: Lines That Weaken a Business Objective
rows: Seeking a challenging position in a reputed company
Says nothing about you and fits every resume
Name the role and one proof
Hardworking, honest and a team player
Claims without evidence
Show it through a project outcome
I want to learn and grow
True of everyone
Say what you will do while you learn
Proficient in MS Office
Too vague to check
Name the Excel functions or reports you built

blocks.heading: Growth and AI Behind a Business Objective
rows: Data analyst route

Needs SQL and a portfolio.
Operations route
Wider openings and quick exposure to the business.
Less specialist pay at the start.
